reason: My bedtime moves every week with shifts, so a timer that counts from when I put the phone down actually fits me, and the 14-day trial with no auto-charge costs me nothing to try. If the side-by-side shows I fall asleep faster, 4,900 won a month is less than one convenience-store snack run, so I'd pay monthly before committing to the year.
objection: The resume-on-tossing thing scares me. If it turns sound back on at 3am when I roll over, or when I'm sleeping in the day after a night shift, it wakes me and I'm done. I'd switch that off on day one, and then I'm not sure the rest is worth paying for over the free 60-minute timer.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison shows no real difference, or the fade-out cuts the sound while I'm still awake, I'd stay on the free version.
